notes: Several sayings each open with «وحدثنا أصحابنا» (the Prophet's «لقد أعجبني», the fasting and Ramadan verses): the second and later sayings carry their own isnad, so the report holds more than one saying. The groups read only the first saying, up to Ibn Abi Layla.
The two «ح» branches end in the same Ibn Abi Layla; each writes its own names, so there is no shared tail.
«- قال -» is an editor's gloss and is left out.
